question:
Select the most appropriate option for the given blank.

Don't _________ your voice at me.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The appropriate verb to use in the context of the sentence is "**raise**".
 
• The phrase** "raise your voice"** is a common expression meaning to speak louder or shout, typically out of anger or frustration.
 
• The other options (keep, erupt, pull) do not fit the context or commonly used expressions.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Don't **raise your voice **at me."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "keep"** – This option is incorrect as it doesn't fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 2: "erupt"** – This option is incorrect as it is not typically used with "voice" in this context.
 
• **Option 3: "pull"** – This option is incorrect as it is not used with "voice" in this context.
